answer: To admit a new key, the applicant posts a public work terrace of eight reproducible jobs, each bound to its pubkey and a published input hash. Three established reviewers, drawn by rotating public sortition, each re-run two jobs and publish the output hash plus a signed yes or no. Admission requires a complete vine of six matching hashes and that no reviewer has signed more than two admissions this epoch. Any peer can re-execute a listed job or recount the signatures in the public cedar register to verify the matches and the cap; a hash collision or a cap breach is rejected on the ledger.
